_comment: Declarative post-slice fixes for Gangster1. Applied by touchup.py at the end of slice_concept, so a re-slice cannot lose them. Each entry exists because the concept cannot express it, not because the drawing is wrong.
_hide_why: HoseFlamethrower is active in the default pose while FuelTankFlamethrower is not -- a hose with no tank, i.e. a permanent stray element rather than part of the flamethrower weapon. sharedassets7#127 is referenced by Gangster1 and Vinnie only, and both are the same archetype. The hose carries no Collider2D, so blanking its pixels moves no collision.

net._why: foregrip stack: 58 (x257), 60 (x258), 61 (x264) each carry a whole hand, so the stack shows three sets of fingers on one handguard
same stack, second placement also at x301

_net_why: Keep 58_HandBack: its left edge (x257) sits against the drum magazine (x214-262), so it is the hand nearest the magazine. 60 and 61 are the redundant ones. 'keep' punches the netting open wherever 58 is opaque, because 60 and 61 paint on top of it and would otherwise bury the hand that is meant to survive.

transplant._why: ZombieSoldier's Hat is a genuine WWII steel helmet (132x89). A fedora is a brim and a helmet is a dome; no redraw inside the fedora's outline grows one. Transplanting into this character's own Hat texture keeps its pivot, PPU and size, so it stays an equal-length pixel edit.

denet._why: The concept drew the helmet AND its camo net inside the head sprite. Once the transplant supplies the helmet, that copy is redundant, and the net hanging below the transplant's brim eats the forehead -- the face reads as 'cut off'. The original head sprite has the identical alpha silhouette, so its skin mask is the ground truth for where skin belongs: heal every pixel the original calls skin and the redraw calls dark. The brim shadow and the black left edge are dark in the original too, so they are left alone; the ear is carved out because the redraw shadows it hard and the original does not.

_denet_why: gray_max divides net (~78 gray) from skin (~138). 'detail' is where the face's own brush detail is lifted from to re-texture the patch; a plain diffusion averages the strokes away and the forehead comes out as a smooth sticker. shade_top is the helmet brim shadow at the top of the healed band.
